item.title: Beyond the badge: Expanding investigative capacity in a shrinking workforce
item.description: Integrating civilians, structured internet sleuth programs, artificial intelligence and regional partnerships may be the key to sustaining clearance rates in the 21st century

item.title: Smarter police recruitment that strengthens retention
item.description: Agencies relying on bonuses and short-term tactics may see temporary gains but lasting staffing stability comes from strategies that improve retention, reputation and community trust

item.title: After winter storm caused power outage, a Tenn. PD officer stayed in mounted unit stables to save horses' lives
item.description: Metro Nashville Police Mounted Unit Officer Michael Douglas tended to horses alone for three days, left without assistance due to downed trees and icy roads

item.title: Conn. city aims to use federal grant to build active shooter training center after deaths of 2 PD officers
item.description: Bristol is working to construct a two-story facility that would house a training center where its police officers and others across the state could practice how to deal with armed attackers in complex buildings

item.title: Jury rejects claim that LAPD officer was killed in training over sexual assault report
item.description: Officer Houston Tipping died three days after he suffered a spinal injury during training; his family sued, claiming he was killed in retaliation for reporting an alleged sexual assault

item.title: Bill would allow law enforcement to take down nefarious drones during 2026 World Cup
item.description: The Counter Drone State and Local Defender Act would allow state and local agencies to apply for authorization to disable drones during major events, including the 2026 World Cup

item.title: Bystander put hand into gun chamber to stop R.I. hockey rink shooter
item.description: Michael Black jammed the gun with his hand and other bystanders put the shooter in a chokehold, subduing the suspect before he died from a self-inflicted gunshot, authorities said
